title: [master] SOA: Bugbash for releases 28.x - Select an existing contact, or create a new one - Use another contact always
summary: Fixed an error when selecting an existing contact in the Sales Order Agent by adding a commit before opening the contact selection dialog, preventing a write transaction conflict.
key_points: The 'Use another contact always' option failed with a form.RunModal write transaction error
Root cause was an active write transaction when ContactList.RunModal() was called
Solution adds Commit() before ContactList.RunModal() in SelectContactAndUpdateEmail, matching the pattern used in CreateContact
The commit is safe because there are no pending writes at this point
Resolves the conflict between the modal dialog and the Contact table's locking chain
